page.title: Loans
page.description: Track loans, repayment plans, and balances in one place.

fields.name: Loan name
fields.originalPrincipalHint: Optional. The amount originally borrowed, if different from the principal above (e.g. when adding a loan you've already been paying off). Used to calculate repayment progress.
fields.amortizationMethodHint: French keeps the payment level; constant principal pays the same principal each month, so the payment falls.
fields.notesPlaceholder: Anything worth remembering about this loan
fields.rateTypeVariableHelp: Enter the rate the loan started with. Add each later change under Rate history on the loan page.

repayment.description: Match repayments to account transactions for accurate balance tracking.

validation.originalPrincipalTooLow: Original loan amount must be at least the principal.

repayments.title: Repayments
repayments.candidatesDescription: Choose a transaction to review and allocate.
repayments.reviewDescription: Confirm the repayment split before saving.

amortization.title: Amortization schedule
amortization.subtitle: Each payment split into interest and principal, and the balance left after it.
amortization.unavailable: The amortization schedule is unavailable right now.
amortization.missingInputs: Add the interest rate and term to see the contract schedule.

payoff.title: Payoff projection
payoff.subtitle: When the loan clears at the contract payment, and how much sooner an extra monthly payment gets you there.
payoff.extraHelper: Added to the contract payment. Leave empty to see the contract-only payoff.
payoff.neverBody: At this payment the balance never clears: the payment does not cover the monthly interest. Raise the payment or add an extra.
payoff.missingInputs: Add the interest rate and term to project the payoff.
payoff.unavailable: The payoff projection is unavailable right now.

adjustment.title: Adjust balance
adjustment.description: Record your lender's balance or another change to the loan. The balance, schedule and payoff projection follow it from its date.
adjustment.emptyBody: When your lender's balance differs from the one shown here, record their figure. It replaces the modelled balance from its date on, and later repayments reduce it from there.
adjustment.deleteConfirm: Delete this adjustment? The balance is worked out again without it.
adjustment.amountPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
adjustment.invalidDate: Pick the date it takes effect.

typeHelp.BALANCE_CORRECTION: Sets the balance to your lender's figure on this date. Zero is allowed.
typeHelp.FEE: Adds a fee charged to the loan to the balance.
typeHelp.CAPITALIZED_INTEREST: Adds unpaid interest to the balance.
typeHelp.PRINCIPAL_INCREASE: Adds borrowed money to the balance.
typeHelp.PRINCIPAL_DECREASE: Reduces the balance outside a linked repayment.
typeHelp.WRITE_OFF: Reduces the balance by an amount the lender forgave.

rateHistory.title: Rate history
rateHistory.description: Each rate applies from its date until the next one. Rates are not fetched or predicted: add each change as your lender announces it.
rateHistory.emptyWithRate: No rate changes yet: {rate} applies throughout.
rateHistory.invalidDate: Pick the date it takes effect.
